_written: 2026-10-09, BEFORE running any gen11 experiment. Thresholds from config/promotion_criteria_crypto.json unless stated.
data_note: Binance funding 2020-01..2023-12 (BTC, ETH); Binance USDT-perp mark prices + funding 2025-08-21..2026-09-20 (21 symbols). index_price is EMPTY in the recent file, so perp-vs-spot basis cannot be measured anywhere: every carry P&L below EXCLUDES basis risk.

C6_FUNDING_CONTRARIAN.statement: When the latest BTC funding print is in the top (bottom) q of its trailing 90-day distribution, BTC under-(out-)performs over the next h hours (crowded leverage unwinds).
C6_FUNDING_CONTRARIAN.data: Bitstamp BTCUSD 1h bars + Binance BTCUSDT funding
C6_FUNDING_CONTRARIAN.grid: q in {0.90, 0.95} x hold in {24, 72} hours; long/short; size 1.0
C6_FUNDING_CONTRARIAN.HOLDOUT: 2025-11-20..2026-09-20, 21 perps on 8h mark-price bars, equal-weight portfolio (only if OOS passes)
C6_FUNDING_CONTRARIAN.pass_train: best-variant net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND residual vs BTC buy&hold-VT >= 0.3 AND >= 3/4 variants net > 0
C6_FUNDING_CONTRARIAN.pass_oos: frozen best TRAIN variant net Sharpe >= 0.5 and residual > 0

C7_FUNDING_CARRY.statement: A delta-neutral long-spot/short-perp position switched on when trailing 7-day mean funding > tau earns funding in excess of costs and a 4% cash hurdle.
C7_FUNDING_CARRY.grid: tau in {0, 0.00005} per 8h; BTC and ETH
C7_FUNDING_CARRY.costs: each switch = spot leg 15 bps + perp leg 7 bps (22 bps per unit turnover); capital = 2x notional (spot fully paid + perp margin held at 1x for liquidation safety)
C7_FUNDING_CARRY.metric: annual net return on CAPITAL; basis P&L NOT modelled
C7_FUNDING_CARRY.pass: net return on capital > 4% p.a. (cash hurdle) in TRAIN, OOS and HOLDOUT separately, and tau-rule beats always-on in at least OOS
C7_FUNDING_CARRY.ceiling: cannot exceed EXPLORATORY because basis/exchange/counterparty risk is unmodelled

C8_CALENDAR.statement: BTC returns differ systematically by UTC hour-of-day or weekday.
C8_CALENDAR.tests: 24 hour-of-day + 7 weekday mean-return tests on Bitstamp 1h log returns in TRAIN 2015-2019; Newey-West t (lag 24 for hours / 5 for days on daily series); Holm across 31 tests at alpha 0.05
C8_CALENDAR.survivors: each Holm survivor becomes a rule: long (or short) during that hour/day only, 7 bps per entry/exit; must have net Sharpe > 0.3 in VALIDATION 2020-21 and > 0 in OOS 2022-23

C9_FUNDING_REGIME_FILTER_FOR_CT1.statement: Zeroing CT1 long exposure when BTC funding is above its trailing 90-day 90th percentile improves CT1 risk-adjusted return.
C9_FUNDING_REGIME_FILTER_FOR_CT1.period: 2020-07..2023-12 for development (CT1 OOS already viewed - classified as REGIME ANALYSIS, not new alpha); then 2025-08-21..2026-09-20 BTC as confirmation
baselines: random skip with matched skip rate (500 draws, report percentile)
risk-reduction: halve position instead of zero
C9_FUNDING_REGIME_FILTER_FOR_CT1.pass: filtered Sharpe exceeds unfiltered AND exceeds the 95th percentile of random-skip in dev AND improves in confirmation

C10_XS_ALT_MOMENTUM.statement: Among the 12 mirror alt/major coins, those with the highest trailing 30-day return outperform over the next week (cross-sectional momentum).
C10_XS_ALT_MOMENTUM.data: mirror daily closes 2018-2023 (SURVIVORSHIP-BIASED universe chosen ex-post; venue undocumented)
C10_XS_ALT_MOMENTUM.rule: weekly rebalance, long top-3 short bottom-3 equal weight, 15 bps
